## What this changes

## Why

If there is an issue, link it.

## How you tested it

Say what you ran and what you saw.

## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits, for example `fix: ...`
- [ ] `pytest` passes with no network
- [ ] `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass
- [ ] The diff has no password, account number, meter number, address, real portal response, CSV download, or HAR file
- [ ] The integration still only reads from the portal
- [ ] A changeset is in `.changeset/`, or the change is not visible to a user
- [ ] The README and `docs/protocol.md` are up to date
